title: GPs
description: Find out about GP services, including how to find and register with a local GP and how to book an appointment.
body:
Find out about GP services, including how to find and register with a local GP and how to book an appointment. If you're registered with a GP surgery, you may be able to book or manage appointments and view test results using the NHS App. Find out how to access your NHS account . - Register with a GP surgery - Appointments and bookings at your GP surgery - Using an online form to contact your GP surgery - Video consultations - What to ask your doctor or other healthcare professional - Accessing health services for someone else (family and carer access) - Getting a fit note - View your test results

Related services

- Referrals for specialist care - Book an appointment using the NHS e-Referral Service - Coronavirus (COVID-19) vaccine
